name: al-folio Bootstrap
title_zh: 学术主页模板，论文列表和头像都替你排版好
tagline_zh: 别人花三天调 CSS，你十分钟填内容。论文、项目、履历、社交链接全在一个页面。
tagline_en: Others tweak CSS for days; you just fill in content. Papers, projects, bio, socials on one page, deploy to GitHub.
why_zh: 不是又一个空壳主题——它把学术人最常用的区块（论文、时间线、标签）做成现成组件。
why_en: Not another empty theme—it ships ready-made blocks for papers, timelines, and tags, even citation formatting is handled.
limit_zh: 只适合个人学术主页，不含博客评论、多作者协作或课程站点功能。Jekyll 环境需自备；不会改 Ruby 依赖的。
limit_en: For personal academic sites only—no blog comments, multi-author, or course support. Requires Jekyll setup; you must configure _config.yml yourself.
title_en: Academic homepage template with pre-styled papers and.
